beats.t: Neo couldn't get up. Propped on one arm, he looked up at Yeoni. His lower body rippled like a reflection in water.
Nothing surrounded them. Only fragments of swallowed things drifted like dust: a birthday-cake candle, a graduation photograph, a name tag.
“A note. Strange one, aren't you? You came all this way trusting one note.”
Yes. It's my handwriting.
“I don't know you. I'm sorry.”
Pain stabbed Yeoni's chest. They couldn't remember him either, yet hearing that he didn't know them felt like abandonment.
That's okay. I don't know you either. We're even.
“Even?” Neo gave a short laugh. “I've heard that way of talking somewhere.”
(Somewhere. I hope it was from me.)
Yeoni sat beside Neo and laid the umbrella across their knees. His gaze rested on its taped handle.
“That umbrella. Three layers.”
How do you know?
“I don't. I just noticed. Two would have been enough.”
Three makes me feel better.
Neo's eyebrows shifted slightly. Yeoni didn't miss that tiny response.
My note says you scold a lot.
“Slander.”
See? Already talking plenty. Silver hair matches too. Cat, then human... I must have seen that myself.
“What's this about socks?”
No idea. But apparently you talked about them all the time. Yundal said so.
“Who is Yundal?”
Someone you were very jealous of. I almost added that to the note too.
Neo tilted his head. Somehow the gesture was familiar. Yeoni tried to smile and choked up instead.
How touching. But time is short, vessel.
The surrounding darkness became a voice. Every time its sound touched Neo, his outline faded.
You want him back? There is one way. Speak his true name. It is written on the floor.
Three syllables appeared beneath Neo. The space between the first and last was blank.
[ Park □ Ha ]
The middle's missing.
You know it. On the tip of your tongue, isn't it? Say it and every memory returns. Every day you shared with him.
It really was on the tip of their tongue. The shape of that syllable. All they had to do was say it. Everything lost beneath the tower seemed ready to return at once.
Let me show you what you lost.
Scenes flashed over the darkness. A cat on a rainy night. A hat-wearing cat on an island, dark blue cloak streaming. A large hand tilting an umbrella. Only the face remained hidden.
Show me his face. Just his face.
Speak the name and you'll see. A simple trade.
“Don't say it.”
Neo raised his head. For the first time, strength returned to his eyes.
“I don't know you, but don't say that name. I don't know why. I only know you mustn't.”
If I do, you disappear.
Neo couldn't answer. Yeoni stared at the blank space on the floor.
I wrote this down too.
Yeoni opened the notebook. Wet paper had blurred in places, but it was still readable.
[ Neo · Cat, then human · Silver hair · Lots of scolding · Socks · Umbrella · Once arrived late · On my side ]
There's no Park-whatever anywhere here. This is the only name I wrote.
That isn't a name. It's a nickname you invented.
Right. I invented it. So it's mine. You can't eat it.
Yeoni laid a hand on Neo's forehead. The gold renewed by rain spread slowly from their palm.
Neo.
Nothing happened. Once more.
Neo. Wake up. I told you, one star.
Neo's eyes opened wide. White light filled his blurred fingertips. The joints of his fingers became clear one by one.
“I believe I said I wouldn't get up until I received five stars.”
You never said that.
“I did. In a dream. Under cherry blossoms.”
Light spread along his arms, shoulders, chest. The darkness erasing him withdrew. A pulse beat beneath Yeoni's palm.
The hand they had first held on the ship. The face always beside them. No stranger was returning. Their shared time was finding its place.
Sorry I'm late. Again.
Late again. Definitely one star.
One is enough. Better than zero.
The cat of the first night. Breath supported on the island. The first hand held on the ship. Even the last scolding as they were pushed up from the tower. Scattered memories linked together.
Socks. You told me to wear matching socks. What kind of last words are those, idiot?
Everything else was too long. I wanted to leave you at least that.
The middle syllable returned too. Yeoni knew it. They rolled it silently inside their mouth. Made no sound.
I know your name. I remember everything. But I won't say it. You're Neo. The name I gave you.
Do you remember what I hid now?
Yes. That you'd disappear if your name was spoken. Why decide that alone? You should have asked me.
Because you'd have said no.
Of course I'd say no! That's why you should have asked!
Yeoni hit his chest with a fist. Not very hard. The second fist simply stayed there.
Decide something like that alone again and you get negative stars.
I don't believe negative ratings exist.
They do now.
The light subsided. Neo stood in human form, clear to his toes. Only after taking his hand did Yeoni lift their head.
What have you done? That name has no value. No power.
A powerless name requires no payment. Even the universe probably didn't know that.
Yeoni's left hand heated again. Not only the palm this time. Inside their chest, where the empty column of their chart had been.
Yeoni! Can you hear? Now! Eul and Gyeong, if you two unite!
Yundal's voice came from beyond the gap. Moka's rap continued, voice cracking, rhythm faltering.
Yeoni's Eul and Neo's Gyeong drew together. Like a vine winding around a metal pillar. Metal supporting the vine instead of cutting it.
[ Year: Im-o · Month: Byeong-o · Day: Eulhae · Hour: Gyeong-Chen · 8/8 ]
Full. All eight spaces. The space that was empty since the app first appeared.
The Eul–Gyeong union. Wood and Metal unite into Metal. A blade, not a vessel.
No. It must be empty. A vessel must be empty.
But I'm full. With nothing borrowed from anyone. All my own.
If the vessel fills, where am I to go? Where am I...
At last, Black Moon's voice grew small. Like a hungry child's. For a fleeting moment, Yeoni felt pity in that sound.
You decide. In your own place, not someone else's vessel. But it won't be here.
Neo stepped in front of Yeoni. Silver hair and gold-embroidered clothes stood clear in the darkness. This time, using light didn't wear his body away.
Let's go. Everyone's waiting. If Moka's rap gets any longer, that'll be the greater danger.
The black sun collapsed from within. The moment the vessel filled, Black Moon lost its support. Yeoni and Neo were flung through the split.
They tumbled onto a black panel. Moka's rap stopped dead on its last line. Yundal withdrew his hand and sank down.
Out. Both of you. No encore needed.
I said one song, and you sang three. Moka, you really are fire.
Mr. Cat.
Seo Hanbi.
They faced each other. Neo, freed from a cat's body; Seo Hanbi, freed from a tiger's. People who had crossed the same spring to reach this place.
Thank you. For staying beside this one.
Repaying me? Then I'll accept. This once.
What did you two do in there, anyway? Why's Yeoni's face red?
Nothing! I just called his name!
Just a name, and the Hour Pillar filled? With compatibility that strong, I should retire.
Yundal. Remove that hand. From Yeoni's shoulder.
Ah, that jealousy. You're truly back.
There was no time to celebrate. The black sun screamed. Its five eyes burst one by one. It shrank: fist-sized, then seed-sized.
This isn't over. If there are no skies to eat, I can eat what lies beneath them.
The black seed pierced a panel and fell. They had thought only darkness lay below. But where it fell, an enormous root appeared.
That's... the root of every sky. The World Tree.
If it eats that, not just five skies but every sky ends. Reality too.
Then we follow. All together.
I'll take the front too this time. A whole step, not half.
My voice is gone. You lot make the noise this time. Especially the cat.
Yundal silently put his glove back on. The black circle spread to his wrist and showed beyond it. No one mentioned it.
Neo offered his back. Yeoni hesitated, then wrapped their arms around his shoulders. This time, their hands didn't pass through. They held his back a little tighter.
